input.title: Incorrect alert when Redo/Undo adding Notes as Set Descendant
input.body: ## Step to reproduce 1. Create a thought 2. Add text 3. Tap Note 4. Type a text for the note 5. Tap Undo button ## Current behavior Note text is undone and "Undo: Set Descendant" alert is shown. This also valid for Redo ## Expected behavior The first Undo should show "Undo: Edit Note" The later Undo should show "Undo: Add Note" This should be implemented for Redo as well
